headline: Solex Energy and subsidiary bag Rs 194.14 crore solar module orders
hook: Strong order book growth for solar maker
summary: Solex Energy Limited and its subsidiary, Solex Green Energy, have secured combined work orders worth Rs 194.14 crore for TOPCon Solar PV Modules. The announcement was officially communicated to the exchange via a press release dated October 06, 2026. This sizeable order win boosts the company's execution pipeline in the renewable energy sector. Indian retail investors tracking small-cap green energy plays should note the order inflow's impact on future revenue visibility.

hook: New solar order adds to order book
